title: feat(helper): add methods to request and retrieve recommendations
body:
**Summary**

This PR adds methods to algoliasearch-helper that can build a list of recommendations queries and trigger a request to the Algolia API.

> [!NOTE]
> A few TODO are left for subsequent PR that handle events and transforming the recommend results. In the meantime events for `change` and `result` have a `recommend:` prefix.

**Result**

The helper can now interact with the Recommend API using an up-to-date search client.

A test implementation (without the transformed result structure) is on CSB: https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/infallible-rosalind-3df2mk?file=/src/product.js.

FX-2786
